description: Cross-time-zone meeting planner — Find meeting slots that fall inside working hours in every given IANA time zone on a date: merged overlap windows in UTC with each zone local time, a suggested slot, and the best partial overlap when none exists. DST-aware, weekends excluded by default. Offline. JSON. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the first zone (default today)

zones.description: 2-8 IANA zones, comma separated, e.g. America/New_York,Europe/London

name: time_meeting_planner
